745150101.text: #Hmm? Is that you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon? Ah, wonderful, excellent timing! I was just about to head to the Adventurers' Guild to post a commission!

745150102.text: #Well, well, well! A commission, coming right to us? Guess we're eating good tonight, {NICKNAME}!

745150104.text: Oh, uh, that's right. As famed adventurers, we've got some standards when it comes to our fees...

745150105.text: Don't you worry about that! As long as you manage the various experimental modules as you did before, you'll be well compensated — I guarantee it!

745150107.text: *sigh* Have you forgotten me again? It's me, Hosseini, a researcher from Sumeru. We've worked together a bunch of times already, you know...?

745150109.text: I hope you recall the Energy Amplifier, at least?

745150113.text: ...Oh, right! It's you! You're the one from The Chasm!

745150114.text: You're a lot more cheerful than when we saw you last... No wonder we didn't recognize you.

745150115.text: Hehe, is that so? I guess I'm just that happy, then — I haven't been this lucky in a long while.

745150116.text: Huh. What happened? C'mon, tell us!

745150117.text: Well, it's a long story. After we parted last time, I returned straight to the Akademiya and proposed the idea of an artificial Energy Amplifier based on the data we collected.

745150118.text: At first, my mentor seemed very excited by the proposal. Gave it the "highest praise" right on the spot, in fact. And then...

745150120.text: He booted me out of Sumeru to make me run errands for him in Fontaine.

745150121.text: Wait, what? Why? Didn't he praise you?

745150122.text: Oh, he did praise me! For having the gall to submit a fantasy novel as a project proposal, I mean.

745150123.text: Err, no matter how you spin it, that's definitely not praise...

745150124.text: Indeed. I, too, found myself trapped in a pit of despair for some time. However, I had the good fortune of encountering some fine partners and investors here — they took up my project immediately.

745150125.text: With their assistance, I've successfully integrated my previous research with Fontainian techniques to create an artificial Energy Amplifier — the "Hosseini Amplifier."

745150126.text: As long as it passes the tests as my calculations predict it should, forget the trials of the God of Wisdom — I may yet even become a Sage.

745150127.text: Haven't even graduated yet, have we?

745150128.text: Ahem! No need to fuss over meaningless confounding variables like that. That's just a tiny twist on the road to success.

745150129.text: The most important thing now is to experimentally verify the actual performance of my Amplifier. That's why I need volunteers to test it within Domains.

745150130.text: #Well, then, {NICKNAME}, would you like to volunteer to test my Hosseini Amplifier?

745150112.text: What about "Amplifier Man," then? Surely that rings a bell!
